verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator documents a QR-code transfer that exports codes from the old device for scanning on a new one. Users confirm it can bundle all codes into one QR code they can print as a backup, and codes can also sync through a Google Account. However, the evidence frames this export mainly as re-import into Google Authenticator itself, and a user reports Google makes it 'stupendously difficult' to get a simple text export to a file, so open-format portability for leaving is weak. Missing for 10: documented open/plain-text export format, an officially documented path to migrate to other apps, file-based export.
